iOSReviewNotes:
Scriptum is a native Markdown editor for iPhone and iPad. No Scriptum account or sign-in is required for local writing, organization or export.

Start: choose "Spaces und Bibliothek öffnen". Build 11 opens the page list first. Create or open a page to write. Formatting, undo/redo, comments, replies, saved revisions and export are available from the editor.

iCloud is optional: use the cloud toolbar button in the page list, or More > iCloud-Synchronisation while editing, then iCloud aktivieren. This uses the system iCloud account and CloudKit private/shared databases. There is no separate synchronization server or Scriptum account. Local writing works without iCloud. Account/service availability is checked at runtime; the Diagnose section shows bounded error codes without document or account contents. A previous tester report showed a local synchronization-storage error; this build corrects reproduced transport-file capacity failures and preserves the original callback diagnosis. It does not claim to fix every device account or service condition.

Optional AI: choose KI / KI-Zugang in the editor. The context identifies the selection, paragraph or whole page and selected recipient before sending. Apple Private Cloud Compute, OpenAI/Anthropic API keys and ChatGPT sign-in require the respective provider/device/account/region eligibility; none is required for local writing or export.

Build 11 replaces build 10. Proofreading, rewriting and summarizing now first show the context and chosen provider; the explicit Starten button sends the request. Merely opening the dialog sends nothing. iCloud account/service errors retain their bounded error code directly in the visible dialog; an unavailable account response is not presented as proof that the device is globally signed out. The latest tester account condition has not been reproduced on their device. Earlier library-entry, transport-capacity and safe-receipt corrections remain included. No advertising or tracking SDK. Experimental native multilingual rule-engine research is not included or claimed as a feature.
macOSReviewNotes:
Scriptum is a native macOS Markdown editor, not an iPad/Catalyst application. No Scriptum account or sign-in is required for local writing, organization or export.

Open or create a page in the library. Native text editing, formatting, undo/redo, comments/replies, revisions, templates, outline/links, tables, attachments and export are available from the workspace and Bibliothek menu. PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, ePub and blog output use theme-based previews.

iCloud is optional: choose iCloud in the library sidebar, then iCloud aktivieren. It uses the system iCloud account and CloudKit private/shared databases; no separate synchronization server is operated. Local writing works without this connection. Diagnose exposes bounded version/status/error information without manuscript or account contents. This version includes corrections for reproduced durable transport-file capacity failures for extensive revision histories and batches exact-revision receipts while retaining newer local edits.

AI is optional. Apple Private Cloud Compute, OpenAI/Anthropic API keys and ChatGPT sign-in depend on provider/device/account/region eligibility. No AI account is required for writing or export. Planned AI work requires explicit activation and uses the selected access and supported execution conditions; successful execution is not promised when those conditions are unavailable.

Build 14 replaces build 13 with a continuous paper writing area, compact native toolbar, named Ansicht and KI controls, clearer sidebar symbols, stateful inspector controls and adaptable assistant dialogs with a legible dark-mode close button. Merely opening a proofreading action sends no request: review the context/provider and click Starten. Direct chat edits remain revision-bound and undoable. iCloud error codes are visible directly in the dialog. Earlier templates, writing tools, local task access and transport-capacity corrections remain included. No advertising or tracking SDK. Experimental native multilingual rule-engine research is excluded.
iOSWhatsNewDE:
Verbesserungen für Schreiben und iCloud:
• Lektorat, Überarbeiten und Zusammenfassen starten über einen klaren Dialog mit „Starten“.
• Genauere iCloud-Meldungen mit direkt sichtbarem Fehlercode.
• Verbesserter Zugang zur Bibliothek und zur iCloud-Synchronisation.
Deine lokalen Texte bleiben ohne iCloud oder KI-Zugang verfügbar.
iOSWhatsNewEN:
Writing and iCloud improvements:
• Start proofreading, rewriting and summarizing from a clear dialog with an explicit Start button.
• More precise iCloud messages with a directly visible error code.
• Improved access to your library and iCloud synchronization.
Local writing remains available without iCloud or AI access.
macOSWhatsNewDE: Überarbeitete native Mac-Oberfläche mit durchgehender Papieransicht, kompakter Symbolleiste und klaren Menüs. Flexiblere KI-Dialoge und besser lesbare Bedienelemente im Dunkelmodus. Lektorat beginnt erst nach „Starten“. Genauere iCloud-Meldungen mit sichtbarem Fehlercode.
macOSWhatsNewEN: Refined native Mac interface with a continuous paper canvas, compact toolbar and clearer menus. Adaptable AI dialogs and more legible dark-mode controls. Proofreading begins only after Start. More precise iCloud messages with a visible error code.
